title: From geometry to phenomenology
summary: Precision calculations in quantum field theory rely very often on perturbation theory and thus on the computation of Feynman integrals. Feynman integrals are also fascinating objects from a mathematical point of view and show deep connections to algebraic geometry. Cutting-edge Feynman integrals usually have geometries of "mixed" type, for example parts of it may correspond to a K3-surface, other parts may correspond to curves of a certain genus and the simplest parts correspond to points.
